title: Apply single imports and negated eliminations in place in Lean lemmas
summary: Shrinks the generated Lean lemmas by cutting negated literals with Or.neg_resolve, applying single-use lemmas in place, and routing classical proofs by contradiction through one helper. QF_IDL DTP_k2_n35_c245_s9 drops from 32.2 to 26.1 MB and verifies under Lean's 8 GB cap for the first time.
